dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I have a headache, and I have a sore throat.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈhæv ə ˈhɛdeɪk, ənd aɪ ˈhæv ə ˈsɔːr ˈθroʊt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I think so. I feel hot.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈθɪŋk ˈsoʊ. aɪ ˈfiːl ˈhɑːt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Do you have a cough, too?
dialogue.reading: duː juː ˈhæv ə ˈkɔːf, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. I cough a lot at night.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. aɪ ˈkɔːf ə ˈlɑːt ət ˈnaɪt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: OK. I think you have a cold.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. aɪ ˈθɪŋk juː ˈhæv ə ˈkoʊld.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh no! But I have class tomorrow.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! bʌt aɪ ˈhæv ˈklæs təˈmɑːroʊ.
